findings.issue: The 'mixed layout lays out only unpositioned nodes' test asserts the stored-positioned node is kept EXACTLY ({999,111}) but for the unpositioned sibling it only asserts Number.isFinite(x/y). It does not assert the laid-out coord actually DIFFERS from the stored node's coord (or is otherwise placed by dagre). A regression where dagre silently no-ops and the unpositioned node keeps a {0,0}/default would still pass as long as 0 is finite.
findings.fix: Add a value-discriminating assertion to the unpositioned branch, e.g. expect(s2.position).not.toEqual({ x: 999, y: 111 }) AND expect(s2.position).not.toEqual(s1.position) (it must not collapse onto the kept node), mirroring the s1!==s2 distinctness check already used in the 'dagre lays out nodes when absent' test. The positioned-kept assertion is already exact; only the unpositioned half is weak.

findings.issue: Mild duplication within one file: 'does NOT render a start node for an event-only funnel (start node optional)' (line 84) and 'start node not rendered for an event-only funnel' (line 198) assert the same invariant (no [data-node-id="start"] for an event-only funnel). The line-84 case adds value (also asserts canvas root + step node render); the line-198 case is a near-subset. Same level, no pyramid violation.
findings.fix: Drop the line-198 duplicate or fold its unique angle (if any) into the line-84 case. Low priority — both are cheap component assertions and the line-84 case is the stronger one to keep.

findings.issue: 'renders the start node broken when on_start entryStepId is null (entry edge deleted)' (line 65) and 'deleting only the start edge leaves a highlighted broken edge' (line 258) cover the same end state (on_start present, entryStepId null -> start node --broken class + entry broken-edge marker). Both are value-checked (assert data-edge-field === 'entry'), so neither is hollow, but they overlap.
findings.fix: Keep one (line 65 is named for the invariant it proves); the second is justified only if it is meant to assert the delete-path that REACHES that state. Since both assert the rendered state, not the delete transition, consolidate. Minor.

summary: Holistic full-feature test audit of 18-funnel-canvas final state across all four axes (coverage / assertion quality / pyramid balance / E2E rationale). All canvas-specific spec files exist on disk and were read in full: useFunnelCanvas.spec.ts, FunnelCanvas.spec.ts, FunnelCanvasSidePanel.spec.ts, funnel-editor.spec.ts, required-keys.spec.ts (frontend); FunnelControllerIT, FunnelExecutionEngineIT, FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest, FunnelServiceNotesTest, FunnelStepTest, TriggerTest, CanvasPositionDtoTest (backend). COVERAGE: every tech-spec Testing Strategy checklist item is present and mapped to a real test, including the items the task flagged as high-risk: edge->field with null-not-'' (useFunnelCanvas.spec.ts 'no edge serializes to null not empty string' asserts toBeNull AND not.toBe('') per field + siblings unchanged); dagre absent/present/mixed + forced-failure grid fallback (vi.spyOn(dagre,'layout')->throw exercises the real try/catch branch with deterministic grid coords); delete auto-clean with EXACT count=4 and surviving edges value-asserted; broken-edge missing-target + on_start entryStepId==null; notes isolated from steps[] (id-list assertion, not 'every !== undefined'); cross-funnel SUBSCRIBE exit-badge-not-edge. copyOf is asserted as ITS OWN separate seam (FunnelStepTest.copyOf_carries_canvasPosition: value + isSameAs + null->null) exactly as the tech-spec mandates, in addition to the HTTP forward+reverse round-trip (FunnelControllerIT.canvasPosition_step_and_trigger_round_trips, asserts a sibling 'next' unchanged). Server-minted note id (ObjectId-hex regex), dup-id reject, id-shape reject, finite-coord validator (CanvasPositionDtoTest, constructed in Java to actually reach @AssertTrue), notes cap boundary (50 accepted / 51 rejected), and Trigger.canvasPosition equals/hashCode-excluded are all covered. ENGINE SEMANTICS: next==null ends branch with the array-neighbour proven NOT to fire (sentCount==1, currentStepId null); on_start enters entryStepId regardless of array order (asserts currentStepId=='entry', not array[0]); applyTriggers accepts funnel-scoped on_start entry (asserts persisted entryStepId), rejects dangling on_start (422 CODE_INVALID_ENTRY_STEP), rejects non-event entryStepId (negative case), accepts null on_start; funnel_broken_edge 422 regression on activate (button + next variants, code-asserted); step-budget loop backstop (failed status + LOG_STEP_BUDGET_EXCEEDED). ASSERTION QUALITY: assertions are value-based on the right model object with sibling-unchanged checks throughout (connect/disconnect per edge-kind, drag-stop step+trigger writes canvasPosition while leaving next/sibling-trigger intact, side-panel hideTargetPickers preserves emitted targetStepId/timeoutTargetStepId/targetEntryStepId, XSS note rendered escaped with both text() AND innerHTML-no-
coverage_assessment: EXCELLENT. Verified by execution, not just inspection: frontend feature suites 104/104 passed (5 files); backend feature suites green and -- critically -- FunnelExecutionEngineIT ran 69 tests skipped=0 under -PrunSlow=true (the slow @Tag was correctly overridden; the engine ITs genuinely executed and were NOT silently skipped, which the task explicitly warned about). FunnelControllerIT 108/0, FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest 17/0, FunnelServiceNotesTest 7/0, FunnelStepTest 13/0, TriggerTest 4/0, CanvasPositionDtoTest 1/0 -- all skipped=0/failures=0/errors=0. Every Testing-Strategy checklist case and every technical Acceptance Criterion maps to a real, value-asserting test. No CRITICAL coverage gaps (the AC's worst-case -- a missing canvas spec after its producer task completed -- does NOT apply: useFunnelCanvas.spec.ts and FunnelCanvas.spec.ts both exist on disk and are substantive). No major assertion-quality or pyramid findings; only 3 minor items (one weak-half assertion, two intra-file near-duplicates). Verdict: clean.
